name: Kirisaka Tamotsu
source:
The student council president, he has good perception and a calculating personality, but he has some surprising weak spots.
He was raised in a fatherless family so he's used to treating women well. He's popular with the female students.
He and the protagonist have noticed each other at school, but they aren't directly acquainted.
He has a part time job at a cafe a few days a week.
